SELECT yctp.PAYMENT_ID, (SELECT pp.project_id from prj_project pp where pp.project_number = cc.contract_number) project_id, cc.contract_number, ( SELECT bm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master bm WHERE bm.bp_id = cc.tenant_id AND cc.contract_id = yctp.contract_id ) tenant_id_n, yctp.repay_date, ( SELECT cf.times FROM con_contract_cashflow cf WHERE cf.cashflow_id = yctp.cashflow_id ) times, ROUND( nvl( yctp.repay_amount, 0 ), 2 ) repay_amount, ROUND( nvl( yctp.repay_principal, 0 ), 2 ) repay_principal, ROUND( nvl( yctp.repay_interest, 0 ), 2 ) repay_interest, ROUND( nvl( yctp.repay_penalty, 0 ), 2 ) repay_penalty, yctp.confirm_date, yctp.transfer_payment_status, ( SELECT sc.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v sc WHERE sc.code = 'CSH.TRANSFER_PAYMENT_STATUS' AND sc.code_value = yctp.transfer_payment_status ) transfer_payment_status_n, yctp.bank_statement, ( SELECT ct.transaction_num FROM csh_transaction ct, csh_write_off cw WHERE ct.transaction_id = cw.csh_transaction_id AND cw.cashflow_id = yctp.cashflow_id ) transaction_num, ( SELECT sc.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v sc WHERE sc.code = 'CON.CASHFLOW_WRITE_OFF_FLAG' AND sc.code_value = ( SELECT ct.write_off_flag FROM csh_transaction ct, csh_write_off cw WHERE ct.transaction_id = cw.csh_transaction_id AND cw.cashflow_id = yctp.cashflow_id ) ) write_off_flag_n FROM yl_csh_transfer_payment yctp INNER JOIN con_contract cc ON yctp.contract_id = cc.contract_id
and cc.contract_number like concat(concat('%',#{contractNumber}),'%')
and ( SELECT bm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master bm WHERE bm.bp_id = cc.tenant_id AND cc.contract_id = yctp.contract_id ) like concat(concat('%',#{tenantIdN}),'%')
and ( SELECT ct.transaction_num FROM csh_transaction ct, csh_write_off cw WHERE ct.transaction_id = cw.csh_transaction_id AND cw.cashflow_id = yctp.cashflow_id ) like concat(concat('%',#{transactionNum}),'%')
and yctp.transfer_payment_status = #{transferPaymentStatus}
and yctp.repay_date >= to_date(#{repayDateFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS')
and yctp.repay_date <= TO_DATE(#{repayDateTo} , 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS' )+ 1 - 1 / 24 / 60 / 60
and ( SELECT ct.write_off_flag FROM csh_transaction ct, csh_write_off cw WHERE ct.transaction_id = cw.csh_transaction_id AND cw.cashflow_id = yctp.cashflow_id ) = #{writeOffFlagN}
